name: Todd R. Seelman
tagline: Top rated Antitrust Litigation attorney in Denver, Colorado
side_practice_areas: Antitrust Litigation, Business Litigation, Securities Litigation
about: Defending corporations across the United States, Todd Seelman has spent over 34 years handling cases involving Antitrust and other complex business litigation matters. As the Managing Partner of the Denver office of Lewis Brisbois Bisgaard & Smith, LLP for the past 10 years, his practice focuses on antitrust, competition, securities and complex commercial litigation. He also has extensive experience with issues involving multidistrict litigation, federal and state government investigations, and class actions.

Though having decades of courtroom and negotiation experience is impressive, Mr. Seelman brings much more to his practice. He has successfully defended businesses in antitrust lawsuits and before federal and state antitrust regulators. Outside litigation, he advises clients on how the laws apply to their operations and acquisitions.

Among his achievements, Mr. Seelman holds the highest peer rating possible of AV Preeminent* from Martindale-Hubbell; Law Week Colorado listed him as a Barrister’s Best antitrust lawyer; and he has been continuously listed in 5280 magazine as one of Denver’s Top Lawyers for antitrust law. Mr. Seelman has been selected to Super Lawyers continually since 2017

Since 2008, Mr. Seelman has also served as an Adjunct Professor of Antitrust Law at the University of Denver Sturm College of Law and is a frequent speaker at legal seminars on Antitrust issues. He is a member of the Colorado Bar Association, the American Bar Association’s Antitrust Law and Business Law sections, the Federal Bar Association, the Denver Bar Association and the State Bar of Wisconsin.

In 1986, Mr. Seelman received a Bachelor of Arts from the University of Wisconsin-Milwaukee. He then earned a Juris Doctor and graduated cum laude from the Mitchell Hamline School of Law in 1990. He is admitted to practice before the U.S. District Courts for the District of Colorado, the Eastern and Western Districts of Wisconsin; the U.S. Courts of Appeals for the 5th, 7th, 9th and 10th Circuits, and the U.S. Supreme Court.

* AV®, AV Preeminent®, Martindale-Hubbell Distinguished and Martindale-Hubbell Notable are certification marks used under license in accordance with the Martindale-Hubbell certification procedures, standards and policies. Martindale-Hubbell® is the facilitator of a peer review rating process. Ratings reflect the anonymous opinions of members of the bar and the judiciary. Martindale-Hubbell® Peer Review Rating™ fall into two categories – legal ability and general ethical standards.
